pages.title: Dinner today, habits usually
pages.instruction: Listen for the activity, the result and the follow-up question

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.translation: Oi! O que você está fazendo?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I'm cooking dinner. What about you?
lines.audioText: I'm cooking dinner. What about you?
lines.translation: Estou preparando o jantar. E você?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Nice! Do you usually watch movies at night?
lines.audioText: Nice! Do you usually watch movies at night?
lines.translation: Legal! Você costuma assistir a filmes à noite?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Yes, but I usually read before bed. Do you cook every day?
lines.audioText: Yes, but I usually read before bed. Do you cook every day?
lines.translation: Sim, mas geralmente leio antes de dormir. Você cozinha todos os dias?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Not really. I usually order food, but today I'm making pasta
lines.audioText: Not really. I usually order food, but today I'm making pasta.
lines.translation: Na verdade, não. Geralmente peço comida, mas hoje estou fazendo macarrão

questions.prompt: What does Ben usually do for dinner?
questions.answer: He usually orders food; today he is making pasta

pages.title: Usually or today?
pages.instruction: Compare a usual day with what is happening today

pages.title: A message from Anna
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hey! What are you doing? I'm at home right now. I'm making some coffee and listening to music. I usually go to the gym in the morning, but today I'm just relaxing. My sister is watching TV, and my parents are cooking lunch. What about you? What are you doing today?
pages.audioText: Hey! What are you doing? I'm at home right now. I'm making some coffee and listening to music. I usually go to the gym in the morning, but today I'm just relaxing. My sister is watching TV, and my parents are cooking lunch. What about you? What are you doing today?
pages.greeting: What are you up to today?

items.cue: Describe the activity mentioned in the message
items.answer: She is making coffee and listening to music at home
